# Piotr Dudziński — Senior UX Writer / Content Designer

> Portfolio and professional profile of Piotr Dudziński,
Senior UX Writer specialising in digital banking and content systems.

## Who I am
Senior UX Writer with 12 years of experience, including 10 years
in digital banking (Santander Bank Polska). Led content for a mobile
banking app with 3M active users. Holds a Plain Language Certificate —
one of the first in the Polish banking sector. Currently Senior UX Writer
at E-Point (project for Polish Ministry of Agriculture).
Based in Poland, open to remote European roles.

## Key expertise
- Digital banking UX writing (10 years, Santander Bank Polska)
- Content systems, voice & tone guidelines, component libraries
- Plain language in regulated and legal environments
- AI-powered content automation (Make.com, Claude API, Figma plugins)
- Multilingual content (PL, EN, UA, RU, AR)
- Cross-functional collaboration: legal, compliance, UX, product

## Notable work
- Led Plain Language Certificate for Santander mobile banking app
  (3M users) — one of the first in the Polish banking sector
- Built Figma plugin for content operations: 10-15 daily active users,
  bottleneck eliminated
- Built 6-agent AI content pipeline saving 40+ hours/month
